sourceDescription: Choose an image or drop it here. Your files stay on your device.
uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, and BMP. Animated images export as a single frame.
cropHint: Drag inside the selection to move it, or drag its edges to resize. Use arrow keys for fine adjustments; hold Shift for larger steps.
cropArea: Crop selection. Use arrow keys to move it.
optionsDescription: Select a ratio, fine-tune the crop, then preview the result.
resultDescription: Check the exported image before downloading.
invalidImage: This image could not be opened. Choose a supported image and try again.
exportError: The image could not be exported. Try a smaller selection or another output format.
previewError: The image preview could not be rendered. Try another image.
privacy: Processed on your device. No uploads.
